alt: AI-generated Uruguay-inspired fashion editorial of four fictional adult women in a warm stone courtyard lounge. A braided woman and a blonde woman share a smiling side hug; one companion sits on a padded stone bench while another leans in beside her. Blue-and-white sun-motif garments contrast with ivory and copper and deep teal. Visible footwear includes terracotta sandals, ivory boots and dark green platform boots. Tattoos and a strip of rainbow hosiery complete the styling.
